name: 林小羊
purpose: 把确认、处理、对齐与交接说清楚，表情之外补充时间和事实

stickers.caption: 收到
stickers.usage_note: 仅确认收到，不等于已承接或完成
stickers.pose: Sheep sits gently upright while remaining soft and slightly lopsided, one raised hoof in clear acknowledgment, attentive dot eyes, no salute, no props.

stickers.caption: 我看一下
stickers.usage_note: 说明开始查看，必要时补反馈时间
stickers.pose: Sheep leans intently over one plain document with a small magnifying glass held in hoof, body tilts forward, focused neutral face, no text on paper.

stickers.caption: 处理中
stickers.usage_note: 正在处理；关键事项另补预计完成时间
stickers.pose: Sheep leans forward actively typing with two little hooves on a simple plain laptop, wool gathered into forward-weighted shape, attentive dot eyes, small motion strokes on hooves.

stickers.caption: 对齐一下
stickers.usage_note: 正文说清要对齐的目标、范围或口径
stickers.pose: Sheep carefully slides two plain rectangular cards so their top edges align, one hoof on each card, slightly upright focused pose, small single alignment tick. No words on cards.

stickers.caption: 辛苦确认
stickers.usage_note: 正文带上具体对象、链接和确认事项
stickers.pose: Sheep holds a simple document outward toward viewer, one visible empty square checkbox on it and pencil in other hoof, polite small smile, body leans invitingly.

stickers.caption: 联调中
stickers.usage_note: 实际进入联调时使用，正文补环境、接口和阻塞项
stickers.pose: Sheep sits between TWO tiny simple laptop screens, holds the two ends of a cable trying to connect them, focused small dot eyes, wool body bent forward, no text or logos on screens.

stickers.caption: 已同步
stickers.usage_note: 仅在确已发送或更新后使用，不等于对方看过
stickers.pose: Sheep passes a small plain memo from one side to another, two simple identical memo icons with one small arrow between, soft upright body, satisfied mild nod. No UI text.

stickers.caption: 可以提测
stickers.usage_note: 达到约定提测条件后使用，附版本、范围与已知问题；不等于测试通过
stickers.pose: Sheep gently passes a small plain package toward viewer with one tiny checklist card attached showing two neat check marks, attentive mild smile, body leans forward in handoff; no words on package, no finished trophy.
